name: @pipeworx/mcp-watchmode

tools.name: title_search
tools.description: Search Watchmode for movies and TV shows by name (or IMDb/TMDb ID via search_field); optionally filter by type (movie, tv_series, etc.). Returns Watchmode title IDs.

search_field.description: What search_value IS. Defaults to "name". Watchmode REQUIRES this and rejects anything outside the list — notably "title" is not valid.

tools.name: title_detail
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for a Watchmode title by title_id: title, year, genres, plot, runtime, user rating, cast, and optionally streaming sources via append_to_response.

tools.name: title_sources
tools.description: Return streaming availability for a Watchmode title_id — which services (Netflix, Hulu, etc.) carry it in which regions, with subscription/rent/buy type and price.

tools.name: title_seasons
tools.description: Seasons + episodes for a Watchmode TV show ID. Returns episode count, season number, year. Use after title_search to enumerate a show's structure.

tools.name: releases
tools.description: Return recent or upcoming streaming releases on Watchmode; filter by date range, streaming source IDs, content type, and region. Use to track new additions to services.

tools.name: list_titles
tools.description: Browse and filter the Watchmode title catalog by streaming source, genre, network, type (movie/TV), release date range, and sort order; paginates with page + limit.

tools.name: sources
tools.description: Watchmode streaming directory — all sources/services worldwide (Netflix, Disney+, Hulu, Prime Video, etc.) with IDs, name, type (subscription/free/rent/buy), regions, logo. Use as a directory before filtering list_titles by source.

tools.name: networks
tools.description: Watchmode TV network directory: HBO, FX, BBC, AMC, ABC, NBC, etc. Returns network ID, name, origin country. Use as a directory before filtering list_titles by network.

tools.name: genres
tools.description: Watchmode movie + TV genre directory: Action, Comedy, Drama, Sci-Fi, etc. Returns genre ID + name + TMDb ID. Use to filter list_titles by genre.

tools.name: regions
tools.description: Watchmode supported regions/countries for streaming availability (US, UK, CA, AU, etc.). Returns 2-letter codes. Use to constrain title_sources or list_titles to a region.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-watchmode forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the watchmode pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
